title: Fine-Grained Anomaly Perception in Wild UGC-Enhanced Images: A Comprehensive Dataset and Difference-Fusion Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.02529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image enhancement and restoration have become standard back-end operations on short-video and social media platforms to boost UGC visual experience. Yet these processes inevitably introduce visual anomalies--especially in faces, texts, and textures--that directly undermine perceptual fidelity and viewer trust. While existing IQA methods perform well on classic distortions, they target holistic quality assessment and fail to capture the specific, localized anomalies caused by enhancement algorithms in real-world UGC. To bridge this gap, we formally define a new task-quality Anomaly Perception for UGC image Enhancement (UEAP), and contribute the first UEAP benchmark dataset, named UEAP-4k, curated from the real business scenarios. It provides fine-grained annotations for anomaly categories, localization and severity levels. translated_title: 野外UGC增强图像中的细粒度异常感知：综合数据集与差异融合框架
translated_abstract: 图像增强与修复已成为短视频和社交媒体平台上提升用户生成内容（UGC）视觉体验的标准后端处理操作。然而，这些处理过程不可避免地会引入视觉异常——尤其是在人脸、文本和纹理区域——直接损害感知保真度和观众信任。虽然现有的图像质量评价（IQA）方法在经典失真上表现良好，但它们针对的是整体质量评估，无法捕捉真实世界UGC中由增强算法引起的特定局部异常。为了填补这一空白，我们正式定义了一项新任务——UGC图像增强质量异常感知（UEAP），并贡献了首个UEAP基准数据集，命名为UEAP-4k，该数据集精选自真实业务场景，为异常类别、位置和严重程度提供了细粒度标注。此外，我们提出了一种针对野外UGC增强图像的差异融合异常感知方法（DFAP-UGC）……
tldr: 该论文首次定义了UGC图像增强质量异常感知新任务（UEAP），构建了首个来自真实业务场景的细粒度标注基准数据集UEAP-4k，并提出了差异融合异常感知方法DFAP-UGC以捕捉增强算法引入的局部视觉异常。
en_tdlr: This paper formally defines the new task of quality Anomaly Perception for UGC image Enhancement (UEAP), contributes the first fine-grained annotated benchmark dataset UEAP-4k curated from real business scenarios, and proposes a Difference-Fusion Anomaly Perception Method (DFAP-UGC) to capture localized visual anomalies introduced by enhancement algorithms.
